title: Chapter 1455 - 5: The Fourth Path To Transcendence (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1455 - 5: The Fourth Path To Transcendence (Part 2)

Chapter 1455 - 5: The Fourth Path to Transcendence (Part 2)

"White jade steps?"

The Legendary Lords closely observe.

"There are thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps, scattered across infinite dimensional realms."

Lord Wan Xiang looked at the steps and spoke.

"Let's go and take a look."

Lord Haotian took a step forward and immediately appeared before the nearest white jade step.

From this angle, the white jade steps spread upward endlessly, without beginning or end.

"The transcendent power forming these steps is certainly not meaningless."

The Legendary Lords kept scrutinizing, yet none dared to step onto the first step.

"Since none of you dare, I'll go."

Fantian Lord glanced at the other Legendary Lords, then boldly stepped onto the first step.

"Hmm?"

Standing on the first step, Fantian Lord's expression changed slightly, paused for a moment, then stepped onto the second step.

After several dozen breaths, Fantian Lord was already climbing more than ten steps.

"No issue?"

"Fantian is fine?"

Seeing this, other Legendary Lords attempted to step on the first step as well.

"What's this?"

A Legendary Lord's pupils contracted, "I can sense the metamorphosis direction of my own Chaotic Origin Dao. As long as I follow this direction, I can metamorphose towards the Supreme Rule Dao?" "Indeed, I felt it too."

"So Chaotic Origin Dao is not the end. We also have hope to enter the Supreme Rule Dao's level?"

The eyes of the Legendary Lords were fervent.

The Supreme Rule Dao? That is a being on par with the Perfect Time Being.

The Supreme Rule Dao's will is referred to as half a Perfect Time Being because its power influences everything, omnipotent.

Metamorphosing one's own Chaotic Origin Dao into the Supreme Rule Dao? Isn't that transcendence?

"The path of transcendence! As long as you reach the end of the white jade steps, the Chaotic Origin Dao will metamorphose into the Supreme Rule Dao, allowing transcendence. These white jade steps are the path of transcendence, the fourth path of transcendence!" Numerous thoughts surged in the hearts of the Legendary Lords, and they began to climb the white jade steps.

However, most of the Legendary Lords did not choose this set of white jade steps, opting to head for other steps instead.

After the strange fluctuations erupted, a total of thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps were formed, not just the one before them.

Especially Lord Haotian, Lord Wan Xiang, and other lords; with

Fantian Lord already leading on these steps, they didn't wish to compete with him.

"Even if the white jade steps are the path of transcendence, the number of Lords who can transcend is certainly limited. Fantian is

already on this path, so I will choose another."

Lord Haotian turned his thoughts and headed to another set of white

jade steps.

"The path of transcendence..."

The sage's gaze was complex, murmuring to himself, "I wonder how many Legendary Lords will perish this time..."

Having experienced long eras and cycles of great devastation, the sage naturally understood that the path of transcendence is both hope and a dead end. Regarding the fourth path of transcendence, it's unknown how many Legendary Lords have fallen upon it.

"I've lived so long; perhaps I should try this time as well?"

The sage approached another set of white jade steps, equally stirred

by desire.

Though renowned among the Legendary Lords, merely the endless years they've experienced reverently him.

Yet the sage knew that to lords like Haotian, Fantian, and Wan Xiang, there was disregard toward him.

For the Legendary Lords, mere survival doesn't hold much meaning.

To die in pursuit of transcendence is the true end.

"My friends have all died on the path of transcendence; I should make

a gamble as well."

The sage turned his thoughts a thousand times, finally choosing to step onto the first set of white jade steps.

"Hmm?"

In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, feeling the strange fluctuations enveloping the whole dimensional realm.

"The first stage of the second phase of endless trials, my Taiji Primordial Spirit entering a special place, causing me to focus entirely

on it, and now only noticing?"

Lin Yuan furrowed his brows.

Initially believing the first stage of the second phase to be easy.

Which it was indeed, not difficult, yet briefly occupied all of Lin

Yuan's focus.

"Galaxy." Purple Light Legendary Lord messaged, "You should be

aware of the white jade steps, right?"

"Just became aware." Lin Yuan nodded.

"A batch of Legendary Lords has already stepped onto the white jade

steps." Purple Light Legendary Lord remarked, "Across infinite dimensional realms, there are thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps, considered the fourth path of

transcendence."

"The fourth path of transcendence?"

Lin Yuan's eyes showed astonishment as images of the white jade steps appeared before him.

He had seen similar images more than once, three times to be exact.

The last time he saw the white jade steps was over a hundred thousand years ago when the Blood Sea Lord's legendary future self

forced out Lin Yuan's future self, and the future image included the white jade steps.

As for the time before that... It was before Lin Yuan broke through to

being a time lifeform.

Before the time loop trials descended, Lin Yuan slept for two thousand years, dreaming countless peculiar dreams, one among

them featured scenes akin to the white jade steps.

In that dream, he reached the end of the white jade steps, encountering an unbelievable light gate and a blurry figure leaning against its threshold.

"Ascending the white jade steps reveals one's Chaotic Origin Dao's metamorphosis direction, towards becoming the Supreme Rule Dao." Purple Light Legendary Lord spoke, voice also somewhat unstable.

For a time lifeform, the level of Chaotic Origin Dao was already the limit.

Even Legendary Lords possess Daos of Chaotic Origin Dao, only in greater numbers.

And one's Chaotic Origin Dao metamorphosing towards the Supreme

Rule Dao? No wonder the white jade steps are known as the fourth path of transcendence; if true, it is indeed such a path. Why is the infinite trials referred to as the path of transcendence? Because with each passing trial, one's strength increases. Even without ultimate transformation, merely the enhancements from tens of billions of trials suffice for transcendence.

The white jade steps follow a similar principle; as long as one's Chaotic

Origin Dao metamorphoses to the Supreme Rule Dao, that is transcendence.

"Without any restrictions?" Lin Yuan asked.

The infinite trials enhance strength only after completing a trial.

Only through effort comes reward.

"Restrictions do exist." Purple Light Legendary Lord commented,

"Currently, those already stepping on the white jade steps indicate that each step provides direction for one's Chaotic Origin Dao to metamorphose towards the Supreme Rule Dao. Yet, it's merely a direction; you need to comprehend and elevate your Chaotic Origin Dao to that level to ascend the next step." "Moreover, each step bears an inexplicable pressure, with pressure increasing as more steps are climbed."

Pausing momentarily, Purple Light Legendary Lord continued: "All white jade steps may only be climbed by Lords, not by time beings

below the Third Realm? They can at most perceive, unable to touch."

This last point is normal; other transcendence paths also require

attaining lordship to access them.

"I see."

Lin Yuan nodded.

"Here are the positions of the thirty-three thousand three hundred

and thirty-three white jade steps. Galaxy, which one do you choose? So I can avoid you." Purple Light Legendary Lord whispered. In Wanwei time-space, Purple Light Lord remembered Lin Yuan's future self standing atop white jade steps.

Although unaware of the exact height Lin Yuan had reached then, it

was clear that he probably led most Legendary Lords, so Purple Light

Legendary Lord naturally dared not choose the same path of transcendence as Lin Yuan.

"I chose this one."

Lin Yuan looked at one of the white jade steps.

While conversing with Purple Light Legendary Lord, his true self had

already arrived at this set of white jade steps.
